parsed.rationale: All four participating records live in `Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkFetcherTests.swift`, a test file in the `Artwork` package. Although the pipeline has flagged `is_test: false` on each record, the file path (`Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkFetcherTests.swift`) and the enclosing type names (`iTunesArtworkServiceTests.SequentialMockSession`, `LastFMArtworkServiceTests.SequentialMockSession`, `DiscogsArtworkServiceTests.SequentialMockSession`) make clear these are test-internal mock helper types. Each `SequentialMockSession.data` method is a fixture that belongs to its enclosing test class; consolidating them would couple unrelated test suites and obscure per-service test intent. No production code is involved, so no refactor is warranted.
